title: Classes & Objects
explanation: A class is a blueprint; an object is one thing built from it. Fields hold its data, the constructor fills them in, and methods are what it can do.
new Tower("stone_bricks", 5) runs the constructor and hands back an object. Inside it, this.block = block means the field named block takes the parameter named block.
Both towers run the very same buildAt code, but each one uses its own block and height. Add a third with settings of your choosing.
